reason: The first implementation chose an arbitrary internal order for 1-window/2-window path components. Variable relabeling exposed that this was representation-dependent. For 2+ windows, consecutive clauses expose canonical size-2 intersections and no orientation choice is needed. A single 3-clause exposes no canonical pair, so universal relabel-invariant closure of that short-line case is not claimed by this carrier.
corrected_scope: Every same-polarity connected component must contain at least two width-3 clauses and be verified as an exact consecutive 3-window path hypergraph.
For every adjacent pair of windows, their canonical 2-variable intersection is emitted as a disequality edge; no arbitrary path orientation is used for execution.
Bipartite coloring of the union of these canonical disequality edges is sufficient because every source clause in a component with >=2 windows contains at least one such opposite-colored shared pair.

corrected_controls.permuted_dense_family: 64 relabelings with both grid dimensions >=4 must close
corrected_controls.short_line_length3: must OPEN_SHORT_LINE_UNORIENTED rather than use label-dependent orientation
